name: ReturnAddress
summary: Puts the reply channel on the request, so that a replier answers where the requestor asked rather than where it was configured to.

roles.name: ReturnAddress
roles.summary: The property naming the channel the reply belongs on. Carrying it on the message is what lets one replier serve many requestors, each getting its answer on its own channel — and what makes a reply that goes nowhere a defect in the message rather than in the replier.
